name: sieve
description: Give AI the answer, not your inbox.

scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w extension
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-sieve --only firestore,database "vitest run --project rules"
scripts.test:functions: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-sieve --only auth,firestore,database,functions "cd functions && venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests"
scripts.functions:setup: cd functions && python3.13 -m venv venv && venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.bench:setup: cd bench && python3.13 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run check:repo
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions && npm run e2e && npm run e2e:ext && npm run bench:test
